neet_phy_u15_t02_1.working: The Poynting vector E×B must point along +z. Since x̂×ŷ = ẑ, B points along +y.

neet_phy_u15_t02_2.working: Here k = π×10^7 m^-1, so λ = 2π/k = 2×10^-7 m. The phase has the form (kz + ωt), so the wave travels along -z.

neet_phy_u15_t02_3.working: B0 = E0/c = 30/(3×10^8) = 10^-7 T. The wave travels along +x and E is along ŷ. Since ŷ×ẑ = x̂, B is along +ẑ and in phase with E.

neet_phy_u15_t02_4.working: Polarisation needs a transverse wave. EM waves are transverse, while sound in air is longitudinal. Both statements are true, and R explains A.

neet_phy_u15_t02_5.working: Statement I is true: S points along the direction of propagation. Statement II is false: the phase (kz + ωt) means travel along -z. When Ex > 0, B must be along -y so that x̂×(-ŷ) = -ẑ.
